crossRefs.note: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you must do: a third of you, who come in on the Sabbath, shall be keepers of…
The two companies of you, even all who go out on the Sabbath, shall keep the watch of Yahweh’s house around the king.
So the Levites and all Judah did according to all that Jehoiada the priest commanded: and they each took his men, those…

translations.web: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
translations.bsb: Their relatives came from their villages at fixed times to serve with them for seven-day periods.
translations.kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
translations.asv: And their brethren, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them:
